Indian Airforce Airmen Examination 2025 : Eligibility Criteria

For 10+2 Candidates : Candidates must have completed 10+2/Intermediate or its equivalent with Physics , Chemistry, Biology, and English from a recognized board. A minimum of 50% aggregate marks and at least 50% in English are required. For Pharmacy Candidates : Candidates should have completed Intermediate/10+2 or its equivalent with Physics , Chemistry, Biology, and English. Additionally, a Diploma or B.Sc in Pharmacy with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks is necessary . Enrollment requires valid registration with the State Pharmacy Council or the Pharmacy Council of India.

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years

  • Married: Born between 03 July 2001 and 03 July 2004.  ( For Pharmacy Candidates)
